spans.s:
(इ,) पिवि r. 1st cl. (पिन्वते)
To sprinkle, to wet or moisten.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Who or what drinks.
E.
पा to drink, अच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (पीवति)
To be fat or corpulent.

f. (-वा)
Water.
E.
पा to drink, वन Uṇādi aff. form irr.

mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्)
Drinking.
E.
पा to drink, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-वा-वा-व)
1 Fat, large.
2 Strong, robust.
m. (-वा)
Air, wind.
E.
प्यै to swell or increase, Uṇādi aff. क्वनिन्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Fat, large.
f. (-रा-री)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)
(-री)
1 A young woman.
2 A cow.
E.
प्ये to increase, Uṇādi aff. ष्वरच्.

f. (-नी)
1 A cow with large udders.
2 A woman with large breasts.
E.
पीवर large, and स्तन a breast.
